product.name: Equipment Marketplace
product.description: An online platform connecting heavy equipment owners with renters, facilitating equipment rental transactions with flexible pricing and rental durations.

product.name: Equipment Data Platform
product.description: A telematics-based platform that collects, processes, and analyzes heavy equipment data, providing real-time performance metrics and customizable reports via APIs.

product.name: Equipment & Site Management
product.description: A platform that centralizes project data and communication to streamline site operations, resource allocation, and safety management in real-time.
